description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio as a function of the Percent Sequence Ratio (%), comparing two different caching strategies: Full Cache and GPU Mem. Ratio. The x-axis, labeled “Percent Sequence Ratio (%)”, is linearly scaled from 0 to 100, with tick marks appearing at every 20 units. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Perplexity”, is linearly scaled from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick marks appearing at every 0.1 unit. The y-axis on the right, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, is linearly scaled from 40 to 90, with tick marks appearing at every 10 units. The plot contains four lines: an orange solid line with circular markers representing “Perplexity” (Full Cache PPL), which starts at approximately 4.6 and decreases to around 4.35 before rising again to about 4.5; a red dashed line with circular markers representing “Full Cache PPL”, which starts at approximately 4.4 and increases to about 4.55; a blue solid line with circular markers representing “GPU Mem. Ratio” (Full Cache GPU Mem.), which starts at approximately 4.2 and increases to about 4.7; and a blue dashed line with circular markers representing “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, which starts at approximately 90 and decreases to about 60.
